0022600145.text: The Pelicans host the Kings in their fifth game of the season, with both teams still winless at 0-4 and on four-game losing streaks. New Orleans is 0-2 at home and sits 14th in the West, while Sacramento is 15th in the West. Pelicans forward Yves Missi is out with a knee bruise, and Jordan Poole is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. The Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though New Orleans won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, and in their last meeting on April 3, 2026, in Sacramento, the Pelicans lost 117-113.
